scope_caveat: Local optimum over the explicitly tested candidate pool only; not a mathematical or global proof of optimality.

authority.note: PASS covers only the 7 complete configurations in the pool (raw baseline, registry canonical export, preferred five, four-swap without Hexing Squelcher, Pass C's Muddle-over-Seething-Song six-swap, and the Abrade six-swap and Burnt Offering seven-swap alternatives) plus named single-card contenders. They were judged with finite current-Oracle rules cases, Commander Spellbook combo lookups and a quantity-counted mana comparison. Tests run locally and in .github/workflows/m7-cormela-glamour-thief.yml; run URLs are recorded in the PR body. There is no statistical multiplayer ranking. The A/B seals and the owner-equivalent Pass C (final disposition KEEP) are historical, baseline-scoped and not technically independent. Nothing here implies owner approval, M6 certification, M7 approval or a canonical change.
